name: voxel-game
title: Minecraft-like 3D voxel game in the browser (three.js): infinite chunked terrain with trees, walking/jumping/flying physics, break and place blocks, hotbar
tags: minecraft voxel block blocks 3d game three.js sandbox world craft mine cube ماينكرافت ماين كرافت مكعبات لعبه العاب ثلاثيه ابعاد عالم مفتوح بناء تعدين متصفح
run: serve_static (it is an ES module, so it must be served over http — opening the file directly will not work). Entry: index.html
notes: game.js sections: config (CHUNK, VIEW, BLOCKS, HOTBAR) · world (generate, getBlock, setBlock) · meshing · player physics · picking · input · loop. To add a block: append to BLOCKS and its id to HOTBAR. Terrain shape: heightAt(). Structures: inside generate() (keep them 2 blocks inside the chunk). Saving: record setBlock edits in a Map and replay them after generate(). Debug handle: window.game (player, chunks, getBlock, setBlock). Verify with preview_read js: game.chunks.size > 0 && game.player.onGround.
strong: minecraft voxel ماينكرافت ماين كرافت مكعبات

name: platformer-2d
title: 2D pixel platformer on canvas (no libraries): tile levels as text, coins, spikes, enemies, flag, coyote time and jump buffering, camera follow
tags: platformer 2d game canvas mario jump run arcade pixel side scroller tiles level لعبه العاب منصات ماريو قفز ثنائيه ابعاد بكسل كانفاس متصفح
run: serve_static, or open_preview index.html directly (single file, no modules)
notes: Everything is in index.html. Levels are text rows in LEVELS (# solid, o coin, ^ spike, F flag, P start, E enemy) — all rows of a level must have the same length. Feel constants at the top: GRAV, MOVE, JUMP, COYOTE, BUFFER. update() = physics and rules, draw() = rendering. Debug handle: window.game (player, coins, state, load(n)).

notes: Rebrand through the CSS variables at the top of style.css (--brand, fonts). Replace every placeholder text in index.html with real copy for the user's product; remove sections that do not apply. name: api-node
title: REST API with SQLite and a small front-end, zero dependencies (Node 22.13+ built-in node:sqlite): CRUD with validation, pagination, search, uniform JSON errors, static file serving
tags: api rest backend server node sqlite database crud http endpoint json خادم سيرفر واجهه برمجيه قاعده بيانات باك اند اداره نظام تخزين
run: start_server with command "node server.js" and port 3000 (no npm install needed). Front-end is public/index.html served by the same server.
notes: Add a resource: create its table in db.exec, write a validate function, copy the five "items" routes. Test with web_fetch http://localhost:3000/api/items or run_command curl. data.db is created next to server.js — add it to .gitignore.
